title: Show Signature Help
summary: Shows parameter help for the call being typed at the editor caret
intro: Read this while writing a call and you need the parameter list and order of the routine: it shows signature help at the caret, bound to Ctrl+Alt+S.

steps: Put the caret inside the call's parentheses in the editor
The parameter help for the routine is shown

questions.ask: What parameters does the call I am typing take?
